weapons.name: MG 151/20
weapons.note: Forum: stated max effective range 800 m; historical Fw 190 A-8 convergence 550 m. Game default convergence NOT confirmed (one forum post mentions 300 m horizontal). A 2002 article says practical range is about 350 m, so optimal is an estimate.

weapons.name: Aircraft cannons (MK 108, ShVAK, VYa-23, Hispano)
weapons.note: No per-gun range figures found. Forum muzzle velocities: Hispano ~880, MG 151/20 ~850, ShVAK 750-780, MK 108 ~490-540 m/s; the MK 108 is short ranged.

weapons.name: Light flak 20/37/40 mm
weapons.note: A forum quote gives 1000-1200 yards effective for 37/40 mm; ceilings are a class judgement.

weapons.name: Heavy flak 88 mm
weapons.note: Forum: 8000 m effective for standard 88s. Single poster, unverified.

default.note: Not found in any source; field of view and zoom are user settings.
